points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using Azure AI and LangChain, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in enterprise knowledge solutions.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for Copilot Studio agents.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring robust governance guardrails.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing API calls by ~80% per query and optimizing cost for cloud-based GenAI platforms.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in securing production AI systems.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable GenAI solutions using Docker and Azure, ensuring robust pipelines for executive-level delivery.
